learning_proof.limitations: Synthetic customer and invoice data in disposable SQLite databases. This proves this bounded migration policy changed after recorded evidence; it is not a claim of general intelligence or production safety.

ablation.method: Paired deterministic synthetic SQLite workloads. Each condition uses a fresh context; the memory condition first records a cold failure and guarded recovery, then retrieves those observations for the same held-out case. Both conditions include the same direct-index baseline on identical values. Results apply only to these fixtures.

release_memory_ablation.scope: controlled local fault; stateless control is restarted without graph history

adversarial_evaluation.method: Fixed synthetic cases, identical evaluation inputs and recovery budget, one identical prior training task per isolated condition scope; retrieval is disabled for the control. Includes changed schema, unrelated service, and denied merge authorization. Static precondition-aware and fixed guarded baselines are reported, not omitted.
adversarial_evaluation.conclusion: Memory can avoid an initial failed attempt on a repeated applicable task. This suite does not establish superiority over a competent static precondition-aware policy. Generalization beyond the fixed action space is not established.
